Team — initial pricing draft below. I kept it modular so Procurement can pick items into an SOW. Notes after the table.

1) One-time setup / integration fees- KMS/HSM onboarding (HSM attestation + key escrow setup): $18,000 one-time- Residency network setup (VPC peering + private endpoints across two regions): $12,000 one-time- Audit log pipeline (ingest mapping + retention policy config): $6,000 one-time

2) Monthly recurring- HIPAA compliance add-on (policy + BA contract): $3,000 / month- KMS/HSM maintenance & key rotation tooling: $1,200 / month- Audit log storage & tiering: $0.08 / GB / month (we should confirm compression estimates; conservative)- Region surcharge (additional for dual-residency presence): $0.06 / compute-unit / hour (applies if pinned to both us-east-1 & eu-west-1)

3) Commit discounts (12-month commit)- 10% off recurring spend at $150k ARR commit- 18% off recurring spend at $300k ARR commit

4) Concessions to propose- Option A: Waive 25% of one-time setup fees for signed 12-month commitment + 30-day payment terms- Option B: Standard setup fees, but provide $15k in platform credits applied over first 3 billing cycles

Operational notes:- For 6TB/month logs at $0.08/GB => ~$480/month (uncompressed). If we estimate 3:1 compression they may see ~$160/month — I attached an XLS with retention scenarios.- KMS/HSM attestation: we can provide FIPS/HSM config details and a short attestation letter from our infra team; Rachel: we need legal sign-off on the exact attestation language.

Attachments: pricing sheet (redwood_compliance_pricing_v3.pdf), audit-log-retention-estimate.xlsx

If Alex/Ops want to be aggressive we can offer Option B + an additional 5% off recurring for up to the first 6 months. Otherwise Option A is cleaner financially.

-Marcus
